name: Koi Suru Kimochi no Kasanekata ~Kasaneta Omoi o Zutto~
original_name: 恋する気持ちのかさねかた ～かさねた想いをずっと～
source:
This is the fandisc for Koi Suru Kimochi no Kasanekata, with after stories for all six heroines. It’s a new start for the lovers with continuing irreplaceable days as the seasons pass.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/06/19/june-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是《Koi Suru Kimochi no Kasanekata》的同人光盘，包含所有六位女主角的后续故事。对于恋人们来说，这是一个新的开始，随着季节的流逝，不可替代的日子仍在继续。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/06/19/june-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
